newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suryamas Dutamakmur may issue rights.
newsitem.headline: Suryamas Dutamakmur may issue rights.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Suryamas Dutamakmur said on Wednesday it was considering a rights issue.
"It is true that we are considering proposing a rights issue but I cannot give you details now. The plan is still under serious discussion," a company official told Reuters.
Brokers said the stock attracted the attention of mostly local operators on the Jakarta Stock Exchange on talk of a possible rights issue.
At 0830 GMT, it was up 50 rupiah to 600 rupiah on a volume of 2.1 million shares after hitting 625 rupiah earlier in the day. -- Jakarta newsroom 6221 384-6364
